title: Not Like Us, Hunty: Measuring Perceptions and Behavioral Effects of Minoritized Anthropomorphic Cues in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Within-subjects user study measuring behavioral reliance and self-reported perceptions (trust, satisfaction, frustration, social presence) of Black American participants interacting with LLM agents using African American English (AAE) versus Standard American English (SAE).

Within-subjects user study measuring behavioral reliance and self-reported perceptions (trust, satisfaction, frustration, social presence) of LGBTQ+ participants interacting with LLM agents using Queer slang versus Standard American English (SAE).
